object_description: Mechanical winged dragon with 21 agent-planned semantic parts; four limbs, two two-section wings, three-section tail, head and jaw.

parts.label: central armored torso
parts.appearance: large elongated barrel-shaped body with convex overlapping armor plates, extending horizontally between the four legs

parts.label: raised front neck
parts.appearance: thick tall curved tapering column of overlapping broad armor plates, rising upward and forward from the front of the torso

parts.label: upper dragon head
parts.appearance: elongated angular dragon skull with a tapered snout, raised brow ridges and a broad rounded rear hinge region, projecting forward from the top of the neck

parts.label: lower hinged jaw
parts.appearance: long narrow curved lower jaw with tapered front tip and raised tooth-like ridges, set below the snout with a visible open gap

parts.label: left swept horn
parts.appearance: thick tapered backward-swept pointed horn with stepped ring ridges, rising from the left rear upper corner of the skull

parts.label: right swept horn
parts.appearance: thick tapered backward-swept pointed horn with stepped ring ridges, rising from the right rear upper corner of the skull, mirroring the left horn

parts.label: left inner wing spar
parts.appearance: thick curved upright tapered wing spar with prominent circular hinge ends, rising diagonally outward from the left upper shoulder

parts.label: left outer wing panel
parts.appearance: large broad thin angular batlike wing panel with a scalloped lower edge and three raised curved ribs, extending outward and backward from the left inner wing elbow

parts.label: right inner wing spar
parts.appearance: thick curved upright tapered wing spar with prominent circular hinge ends, rising diagonally outward from the right upper shoulder, mirroring the left spar

parts.label: right outer wing panel
parts.appearance: large broad thin angular batlike wing panel with a scalloped lower edge and three raised curved ribs, extending outward and backward from the right inner wing elbow

parts.label: first armored tail segment
parts.appearance: thick tapered curved cylindrical armor segment projecting backward from the rump, with a broad circular joint at its root

parts.label: middle armored tail segment
parts.appearance: elongated curved tapering cylindrical armor segment extending backward and slightly rightward from the thick root tail segment

parts.label: upturned pointed tail segment
parts.appearance: long slender curved conical tail segment tapering to a sharp upward-pointing tip, attached to the middle tail segment

parts.label: front left upper leg
parts.appearance: thick convex armored upper limb with a rounded shoulder housing and narrowing knee end, descending outward from the front left torso

parts.label: front left lower leg and clawed foot
parts.appearance: bent tapered armored shin ending in a broad splayed three-claw foot, extending downward and forward from the front left knee

parts.label: front right upper leg
parts.appearance: thick convex armored upper limb with a rounded shoulder housing and narrowing knee end, descending outward from the front right torso

parts.label: front right lower leg and clawed foot
parts.appearance: bent tapered armored shin ending in a broad splayed three-claw foot, extending downward and forward from the front right knee

parts.label: rear left upper leg
parts.appearance: thick rounded armored thigh with a broad hip hinge and tapered knee end, descending outward from the rear left side of the torso

parts.label: rear left lower leg and clawed foot
parts.appearance: bent tapered armored shin ending in a broad splayed three-claw foot, extending downward from the rear left knee

parts.label: rear right upper leg
parts.appearance: thick rounded armored thigh with a broad hip hinge and tapered knee end, descending outward from the rear right side of the torso

parts.label: rear right lower leg and clawed foot
parts.appearance: bent tapered armored shin ending in a broad splayed three-claw foot, extending downward from the rear right knee
